name: web-app-starter
description: Root orchestration for the web-app-starter monorepo: git hooks, commit linting and cross-package quality gates.

scripts.lint: yarn --cwd backend lint && yarn --cwd frontend lint && yarn --cwd admin lint
scripts.lint:strict: yarn --cwd backend lint:strict && yarn --cwd frontend lint:strict && yarn --cwd admin lint:strict
scripts.lint:fix: yarn --cwd backend lint:fix && yarn --cwd frontend lint:fix && yarn --cwd admin lint:fix
scripts.format: yarn --cwd backend format && yarn --cwd frontend format && yarn --cwd admin format
scripts.format:check: yarn --cwd backend format:check && yarn --cwd frontend format:check && yarn --cwd admin format:check
scripts.type-check: yarn --cwd backend type-check && yarn --cwd frontend type-check && yarn --cwd admin type-check
scripts.knip: yarn --cwd backend knip && yarn --cwd frontend knip && yarn --cwd admin knip
scripts.test: yarn --cwd backend test && yarn --cwd frontend test && yarn --cwd admin test
scripts.build:frontend: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME="Web App Starter" NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001/api DOMAIN_NAME=localhost BASE_PATH= NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH= ADMIN_URL=http://localhost:3002/ NEXT_PUBLIC_PROTECTED_ROUTES= yarn --cwd frontend build:test
scripts.build:admin: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME="Web App Starter" NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_PATH=/api DOMAIN_NAME=localhost BASE_PATH= NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH= yarn --cwd admin build
scripts.build: yarn build:backend && yarn build:frontend && yarn build:admin
scripts.test:e2e: yarn --cwd frontend test:e2e && yarn --cwd admin test:e2e
scripts.verify: yarn lint:strict && yarn format:check && yarn type-check && yarn knip && yarn test && yarn build
